title: Regen Loader Subsystem Instance Attributes
description: Per-instance attributes of a regen loader subsystem, written in the subsystems block of a part JSON: the delivery template and the ammo discovery channel. Attributes shared by every instance of a model (magazine capacity, regen rate, ...) live in the static attribute file referenced by definition and are not described here.

definition.description: Resource address of the subsystem model, pointing at the matching regen loader static attribute definition file.

belt_definition.description: Delivery template: every delivery takes a copy of it, using the same field shape as ammunition content. remaining only expresses the template's own remainder; the source fills it from its actual stock, so a delivery made while holding less than one belt has remaining below length. length is how many rounds one belt holds and the cap on a single delivery, and must not exceed the source magazine.capacity. Weapons that load one round at a time write 1.

container_id.description: Optional content-pack container model, used for item restoration, capacity and presentation; omitting it means virtual feeding. This stage only parses and stores the identifier format; model existence and capacity checks arrive with the item implementation.

label.description: Belt display name, shown literally on the weapon HUD. When empty the display name of the first round type is used. It only affects display and is not part of pool grouping, routing or identity; two belts with different composition may share one name.

ammo.description: Projectile resource address, e.g. machine_max:30mm_ap. Its HUD text comes from that projectile's own language key.

count.description: How many consecutive rounds of this ammo the pattern holds.

pattern.description: Ordered ammunition pattern: entries expand in written order, and the next round sits at (length - remaining) % patternTotal. The same ammo may appear several times; a repeating mix only stores the short pattern instead of expanding every round.

length.description: Capacity of one belt in rounds. Fill it from the weapon's actual feed device; it is independent of the source magazine.capacity, which is how many rounds the source stores. length is also the cap on a single delivery: a source holding less than one belt delivers the rounds it has. A length above capacity is a configuration error rejected at decode time.

recharge.description: Optional self recharge: once declared, the launcher holding the belt refills spent rounds at this rate up to length. Only models whose loaded belt must recover on its own declare this block.

regen_per_minute.description: Recharge rate in rounds per minute.

regen_delay.description: Seconds to pause recharging after a successful shot. Reset on every successful consumption of this belt, so sustained fire produces no recharge.

energy_cost_per_round.description: Energy cost per refilled round, paid from the holder's energy grid; when it cannot be paid the progress waits for the next tick. 0 means free.

discovery_outputs.description: Ammo discovery channels and targets; the loader uses them to discover ammo consumers on the same vehicle. Optional.
